items.title: Interim control by-law on data centres — final vote
items.issue: Council considered a final vote on an interim control by-law pausing new data-centre approvals while staff study land-use, energy, and water impacts.
items.why: A pause at the municipal level is one of the few tools communities have while provincial grid-connection rules (Bill 40) are still undefined.
items.result: Reported as approved 15–1 in coverage of the July 15, 2026 meeting. Confirm against official minutes.

participate.notes: Meeting has occurred — use minutes / video to brief the next round.

items.title: Prologis Meadowvale data-centre-ready campus — ongoing
items.issue: Prologis Meadowvale Hustler Park is marketed as a data-centre-ready industrial campus (available 2027). Residents and the local councillor have pushed for more disclosure on water, power, and operator identity; an interim control motion has been discussed.
items.why: Site-plan / zoning language written for generic employment land can green-light hyperscale loads without a public hearing framed as a data centre.

participate.notes: Not one sitting — watch Planning and Development Committee and Council. Register a deputation with the Clerk before the agenda deadline.

items.title: Motion to study regional data-centre infrastructure impacts
items.issue: A motion asked York Region to study whether combined data-centre electricity and water demand — plus housing and other industry — exceeds planned supply, because lower-tier cities approve facilities independently.
items.why: Vaughan, Markham, and Richmond Hill can each approve projects the others never see. A regional study is how you catch stacked grid and water load.
items.result: See Regional Council minutes / coverage for the recorded vote.

participate.notes: Meeting has occurred. Confirm the vote in Regional Council minutes, then watch the September agenda for the follow-up.
